Hi Priya / Sanjay,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

High-level drivers you shared:
- Data residency + PHI: processing must remain on-prem (no egress of PHI outside Acme datacenter).
- Regulatory: upcoming audit requires full audit logs + KMS/HSM integration.
- Network constraints: strict outbound firewall rules, limited peering options, and intermittent internet for updates (possible air-gap requirements).
- Performance: pilot requires sub-200ms P95 for chat endpoints in your internal network for triage workflows.

Top pain points we heard:
- No current secure way to send PHI to cloud endpoints.
- Ops team needs a reproducible deployment topology for security review.
- Need clear guide for firewall rules, ports, and proxy config to pass procurement.

Goals / success criteria you outlined:
- Proof-of-concept (3 endpoints) inside AcmeHealth private environment by Q4.
- HSM-backed key management for model encryption and signing.
- Audit trail and retention policy compatible with your compliance team.

Immediate next steps (owners & timeline):
1) Redwood to share Private/VPC architecture doc + network checklist — Marissa / Camila — EOD Thu 9/17 (attached).
2) Schedule tech deep-dive with Acme infra + SRE to walk topology and firewall rules — propose Tue 9/21 10:00am PT (please confirm).
3) Redwood to provide rough cost ballpark for Reserved Dedicated vs Private On-Prem options — Marissa — by 9/24.
4) Acme to share internal network diagram and point-of-contact for SRE (Sanjay / IT alias) — Priya — by 9/20.

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf (architecture + options), network-checklist.xlsx (ports, proxies, minimal topology).
